title: Elevators operational in residential buildings with a barrier-free path of travel
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: March 2025 (platform created March 18, 2025, last updated March 18, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies NBC(AE) application to elevators that are to be operational in residential buildings required to have a barrier-free path of travel.
NBC(AE) requires at least one elevator to be available for firefighter use at all times in high-rise buildings, but that requirement does not directly apply to access and use by occupants.
The elevating devices regulation sets rules for the safety of operational devices but does not require an elevating device to be operational.

limitations: A published regulator interpretation of a documented design question, not an applicant file.
Case type is the nearest enum value; this is not an issued variance, appeal or worked example.
Interpretation addresses operation and access; it does not set elevator counts for a given building.
